rationale: Round-5 repo-grounding audit at 3a321066 (spec.md-only delta; prior verifications carry). I approved round 4 with zero asks, so per the BRIEF my duty is a regression check of the round-4 diff in my lens's territory. EVERY FRESH CITATION VERIFIES EXACTLY: derive.go:383 is the some-closed->implement return, and the counting switch at derive.go:354-359 counts only 'closed' and 'in_progress' so a blocked bead is indeed neither - the claim that the just-closed bead forces the some-closed branch, making the round-2 'all blocked -> plan' conditioning wrong, re-derives correctly; derive.go:366 is the empty-lifecycle-subset ModePlan return; complete.go:1434 is exactly `children, _ := phase.FetchChildren(epicID)` inside advanceState with the error swallowed, and the stated consequence is mechanically right (a failed read yields nil children -> lifecycleTotal 0 -> the :366 plan return - a discovery failure serialized as a mode); derive.go:166/:174 are DerivePhaseWithStatus / DerivePhaseWithStatusWithCache, and the G1.2 rationale is true (bare DerivePhaseFromChildren returns review for an all-closed set at :375-377 and cannot express done/idle); derive.go:200-202 is the closed-epic done-marker branch; spec.go:76 is confirmed UNCONDITIONAL (the existing-epic path merge-writes mindspec_phase:plan with no stored-phase check - grounding AC-16's red-on-revert claim that a replay regresses implement to plan); complete.go:1396-1400 is the 'Remaining beads are blocked. Mode: plan' FormatResult branch. HOWEVER, the re-derived trigger inventory is itself incomplete - the round-3/round-4 completeness-claim class recurring: R1.3's complete-row plan leg says that mode is 'reachable ONLY via the empty-lifecycle-subset fallback (derive.go:366)' and R2.3 says the ModePlan branch has 'both actually-reachable triggers' (the :366 fallback and the swallowed-error nil set). There is a third reachable trigger: DerivePhaseFromChildren's all-open branch (derive.go:387). classifyChild excludes non-lifecycle children from the lifecycle count (derive.go:348-352), so completing a NON-LIFECYCLE child (e.g. a bug filed as an epic child) while the epic's lifecycle tasks are all still open yields lifecycleTotal>0, closed=0, in_progress=0 -> :387 ModePlan -> the same FormatResult branch. The route is reachable through the standard flow: `next` claims any bd-ready epic child that passes the title filter with no issue-type filter (SelectWork/SelectWorkByName are type-blind), so a bug child claimed and completed in the plan-approve window (lifecycle all-open - exactly the #248 window) lands there. This trigger SURVIVES the R2.3 fix (unlike the swallowed-error trigger), so it matters downstream: R2.3 requires the message 'reworded to match the true trigger' with wording decided at plan time, and R1.3/AC-2 pin row-vs-message agreement with a fixture built on the :366 shape - a rewording derived from a two-trigger inventory (e.g. naming 'no lifecycle tasks exist') would be dishonest on the surviving third route, and the fixture would not catch it. In a spec whose subject is honest state reporting, at a gate whose method rule is re-derivation, an over-strong 'only'/'both' the tree refutes - in the very sentence that corrects the previous over-strong conditioning - warrants a fix round. Everything else in the round-4 delta re-derives cleanly (R3.6's mechanism claim, AC-16's legs, the In-Scope spec.go extension, AC-2's status-aware rewording, the terminal-rows carve-out's two-layer framing).
concrete_changes_required: R1.3 (complete-row plan leg) and R2.3 (trigger inventory): add the third reachable ModePlan trigger - DerivePhaseFromChildren's all-open branch (derive.go:387), reached when the completed bead is a non-lifecycle child (excluded from the lifecycle count, derive.go:348-352) of an epic whose lifecycle children are all open (claimable via `next`, which applies no issue-type filter). Drop or qualify 'reachable only via the empty-lifecycle-subset fallback' and 'both actually-reachable triggers', and note that this trigger (unlike the swallowed-error one) survives the R2.3 fix, so the plan-time message rewording and AC-2's complete->plan row fixture must account for two surviving triggers (:366 and :387), not one.

findings.title: ModePlan trigger inventory incomplete: the all-open branch (derive.go:387) is a third reachable trigger, omitted by both R1.3's 'only' and R2.3's 'both'
findings.detail: Re-derived at 3a321066: DerivePhaseFromChildren excludes epic/non-lifecycle children from the lifecycle count (derive.go:348-352 continue), so after completing a non-lifecycle child (bug-type epic child) with all lifecycle tasks still open, the derivation hits :387 (all-open -> plan), not :366, and advanceState returns ModePlan into FormatResult's :1396-1400 branch. The route needs no exotic setup - `next` claims any bd-ready, title-matching epic child regardless of issue type, and the all-lifecycle-open window is the same plan-approve window R3's fixture already models. Because this trigger survives the R2.3 swallowed-error fix, a message reworded against the spec's two-trigger inventory can be wrong on a live route, and AC-2's fixture (built on the :366 shape) would not go red. Same completeness-claim class as round-3 G1; the normative requirements (reword to match true triggers; row/message agreement) survive intact once the inventory is corrected.
